summary: Edit the RPM inventory in `/opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer/` (RPM package), `ansible-automation-platform-setup-bundle-<version>` (bundle) or `ansible-automation-platform-setup-<version>` (online); open `inventory` and set your scenario, using an example as a base.
